missions.title: Studio Ready
missions.summary: Create the project structure, run the first server script, and prove Studio is showing useful Output.
missions.objective: Create the project structure, run the first server script, and prove Studio is showing useful Output.
missions.whyItMatters: A reliable project structure and readable Output are the foundation for every later test and review.
missions.startingState: Roblox Studio is installed and you can sign in. No project objects are assumed.
missions.visibleResult: Play mode starts normally, the player appears on the baseplate, and Output contains VERSION 1 SERVER READY with no red error produced by your script.

concepts.name: Explorer
concepts.text: The tree that shows where every object lives.

concepts.name: Properties
concepts.text: The panel used to change the selected object’s name and settings.

concepts.name: Output
concepts.text: The live log that shows prints, warnings, and runtime errors.

concepts.name: Script location
concepts.text: A normal Script in ServerScriptService runs on the server.

steps: Open Explorer, Properties, and Output from Studio’s Window menu.
In Workspace, create a Folder named World.
Inside World, create empty folders named Ground, NPCs, NPCHomes, Resources, and Buildings.
In ReplicatedStorage, create folders named Remotes and GameState.
In ServerStorage, create a folder named Templates.
In ServerScriptService, create a normal Script named WorldServer.
Replace the default line with one line that prints VERSION 1 SERVER READY.
Press Play, read Output, then Stop. Save a local .rbxl backup with a clear name.
Do not add free-model scripts or rename the required folders.
submission: Named hierarchy through Workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ServerStorage, and ServerScriptService
Output from one clean Play test
Optional answer to the understanding question
mistakes: Using a LocalScript instead of a Script
Putting WorldServer in Workspace or ReplicatedStorage
Submitting Output from edit mode instead of a Play test
Leaving the default script and claiming a different message printed
hints: The problem is probably location or script type. Ask: should this line run on the server or only for one player?
Check ServerScriptService > WorldServer, then check that it is a normal Script and not disabled.
A print statement has one function call with the message inside quotes: print( ... ).
Use print("VERSION 1 SERVER READY"), but type the missing quote or parenthesis yourself if Studio marks one red.
Use exactly print("VERSION 1 SERVER READY"). Run Play again and submit the new Output.
missions.understandingQuestion: What is the first place you will look when a script seems to do nothing?
missions.requiredHierarchy:
Workspace
└── World (Folder)
    ├── Ground (Folder)
    ├── NPCs (Folder)
    ├── NPCHomes (Folder)
    ├── Resources (Folder)
    └── Buildings (Folder)

ReplicatedStorage
├── Remotes (Folder)
└── GameState (Folder)

ServerStorage
└── Templates (Folder)

ServerScriptService
└── WorldServer (Script)

tests.name: Server script runs
tests.setup: Open the current project and clear Output.
tests.expected: Output contains exactly one VERSION 1 SERVER READY and no Nick-code red error.

tests.name: Hierarchy exists
tests.action: Inspect the required folders and WorldServer.
tests.expected: All Mission 1 folders and WorldServer exist with exact names and locations.

tests.name: Restart is clean
tests.expected: The message appears again once, with no duplicate scripts or errors.

missions.title: Build the Island
missions.summary: Turn the empty baseplate into a small playable settlement area with a spawn and build site.

missions.title: Add Two Settlers
missions.summary: Create two correctly organised NPC rigs that stand in the world without falling apart.

missions.title: Select a Settler
missions.summary: Click either NPC and move one visible selection marker to the NPC you chose.

missions.title: Place the Resources
missions.summary: Add clearly named wood and stone nodes with invisible navigation target points.

missions.title: Build the Command HUD
missions.summary: Create the on-screen command panel and make it show which NPC is selected.

missions.title: Send Safe Commands
missions.summary: Make the Wood and Stone buttons send validated command requests to the server and show a response.

missions.title: Walk to the Resource
missions.summary: Use pathfinding so the selected NPC reaches the requested resource or reports that it cannot.

missions.title: Gather and Return
missions.summary: Collect at the correct node, return the NPC home, and prevent duplicate orders while it is busy.

missions.title: Show Resource Totals
missions.summary: Store wood and stone on the server and keep the HUD counters visibly in sync.

missions.title: Unlock Construction
missions.summary: Show the hut cost and make construction available only when both resource requirements are met.

missions.title: Build the First Hut
missions.summary: Spend 6 wood and 3 stone and create exactly one hut at the build site.

missions.title: Restart the World
missions.summary: Reset resources, hut state, NPC positions, busy flags, selection, and HUD so the loop can be replayed.

missions.title: Prove Version 1
missions.summary: Run the complete normal loop and important edge cases with no unresolved red runtime errors.

missions.title: Publish Version 1
missions.summary: Publish the tested build, complete any parent account checkpoint, and prove the shared version matches Studio.
